patch:
diff --git a/django/db/models/deletion.py b/django/db/models/deletion.py
index ae82d26340..64eef527cd 100644
--- a/django/db/models/deletion.py
+++ b/django/db/models/deletion.py
@@ -309,8 +309,40 @@ class Collector:
                         sender=model, instance=obj, using=self.using
                     )
 
-            # fast deletes
+            # fast deletes. Combine deletes on the same model when the
+            # resulting query stays within the backend's parameter limit.
+            max_query_params = (
+                connections[self.using].features.max_query_params
+            )
+            grouped_fast_deletes = {}
             for qs in self.fast_deletes:
+                grouped_fast_deletes.setdefault(qs.model, []).append(qs)
+            combined_fast_deletes = []
+            for queries in grouped_fast_deletes.values():
+                if len(queries) == 1 or max_query_params is None:
+                    combined_qs = queries[0]
+                    for qs in queries[1:]:
+                        combined_qs |= qs
+                    combined_fast_deletes.append(combined_qs)
+                    continue
+                combined_qs = None
+                total_params = 0
+                for qs in queries:
+                    params_count = len(qs.query.get_compiler(
+                        self.using).as_sql()[1])
+                    if combined_qs is None:
+                        combined_qs = qs
+                        total_params = params_count
+                    elif (total_params + params_count) <= max_query_params:
+                        combined_qs |= qs
+                        total_params += params_count
+                    else:
+                        combined_fast_deletes.append(combined_qs)
+                        combined_qs = qs
+                        total_params = params_count
+                if combined_qs is not None:
+                    combined_fast_deletes.append(combined_qs)
+            for qs in combined_fast_deletes:
                 count = qs._raw_delete(using=self.using)
                 deleted_counter[qs.model._meta.label] += count
